brief:
UK police arrested Massive Attack frontman Rob Del Naja outside the Labour Party Conference in Liverpool under the Terrorism Act, according to Middle East Eye. Del Naja was holding a sign that read "I oppose genocide, I support Palestine Action," the report states.

The arrest took place during the party conference. Details regarding the specific charges or circumstances beyond the sign's message were not immediately available.
